purpose: Data-completeness check: can the public pump.fun API give complete point-in-time daily copycat creation counts per parent ticker over 2024-2026?
raw_files: data/raw/web/narrpeak/ (69 JSON responses, about 6 MB; ~75 requests at 3-4 s spacing; one HTTP 429 seen on an unknown-param probe)

endpoint_findings.frontend-api-v3 /coins?searchTerm=X&sort: HTTP 200 but searchTerm is IGNORED: returns the newest coins on the site regardless of term (PENGU query returned MS/DICE/SDUST...). The round-12 lead that this path 'returns 200 with created_timestamp' was true but it is not a search.
endpoint_findings.frontend-api-v3 /coins/search-v2?searchT: 200; fuzzy search (e.g. PENGU matches 'Penguin', 'P/ACC Penguin Acceleration'); a few exact/relevance hits pinned at the top regardless of date; limit capped at 50 (limit=200 returned 50); offset is clamped at 500: offsets 500, 550, 600, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000 for TRUMP all returned the identical page (first mint AcvnRE...). Maximum reachable = about 550 coins per (term, sort, order).
endpoint_findings.time-window params: createdBefore, created_timestamp_lt, before, maxCreatedTimestamp, endTimestamp, cursor: all ignored (same page as no param).
endpoint_findings.aggregation: search-v2 results include non-pump launchpads and other chains (program raydium_launchpad, meteora_dbc, EVM contract addresses, None). A pump-only count must filter program=='pump'.

depth_reached_by_newest_550_results.PENGU: 2026-09-30T21:17Z (about 4.6 days; most results are fuzzy 'Penguin' matches)
depth_reached_by_newest_550_results.POPCAT: 2026-08-17 (about 7 weeks; plus a few pinned older coins back to 2023-12-12)

overlap_vs_curve_creates.match_rule: ticker as whole word (regex (?<![a-z0-9])ticker(?![a-z0-9])) in lowercased name or symbol; curve_creates timed by recv; window clipped to the recorder's span 2026-10-01T12:17Z..2026-10-05T03:40Z and to the API's reachable depth
overlap_vs_curve_creates.reading: Inside the overlap the API's pump-program coins contain every recorder coin for PENGU (19/19) and POPCAT (5/5) and 198/200 for TRUMP. The API-only extras are mostly other launchpads/chains plus pump coins created during recorder gaps (>120 s between recorded creates). So within the reachable window the API is at least as complete as the recorder; the failure is DEPTH, not recall.

completeness_verdict: NOT COMPLETE. With at most ~550 results per query and no working time filter, daily copycat counts cannot be reconstructed for 2024-2026 for any parent with more than a few hundred lifetime fuzzy matches. TRUMP (~350 word-matching launches on 2026-10-04 alone, all launchpads) is reachable only for its most recent day. No train (<=2025-06-30) or validation (2025-07-01..2026-03-31) counts are reachable. No P&L was computed.
not_tried: Dune/Bitquery/Flipside (no API keys in the environment); full Solana RPC scan of pump-program create instructions since 2024-01 (hundreds of millions of signatures; not feasible within the 200 MB / politeness budget).
